explanation

residence

wean

nest

chase

argument

(adverb). hoàn toàn

(noun). mất mát

(adjective). Tương đương

(verb). bao gồm

(verb). bù đắp

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

(adverb). một cách đồng bộ

(adjective). cao hơn, trội hơn

striking

(adjective). Nổi bật, gây choáng ngợp

(noun). sự phá hoại

(adjective). nghèo khổ

Ex: She fell in love with a penniless artist.

(verb). khăng khăng, cố nài

(adjective). khắc nghiệt

(adjective). đã từng là

(adjective). thuận lợi, có ích

enduring

(adjective). lâu dài

Ex: It's perhaps the only enduring work of art from the period.

destined

(adjective). định mệnh

Ex: She seemed destined to become a very rich woman.

(adjective). Tối quan trọng

recover

(verb). hồi phục

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

frost

(noun). sựơng giá

(noun). Cảm hứng

Ex: Dreams can be a rich source of inspiration for an artist.

(verb). tiêu diệt

(noun). chuyện vặt, giai thoại

(verb). giả sử

publish

(verb). công bố

(adverb). nếu không thì

(noun). điều kì bí

(noun). của cải

(verb). phân biệt

(noun). học giả

contemporary

(adjective). đương thời

Ex: He is among the best-known contemporary artists.

consist

(verb). bao gồm

Ex: The crowd consisted mostly of college kids and office workers.

compassion

(noun). lòng trắc ẩn

Ex: She was known as a hard woman with no compassion, no emotion.

brief

(adjective). Ngắn gọn

Ex: Could you make it brief? I've got a meeting in ten minutes.

avenue

(noun). cơ hội

Ex: We will explore every avenue until we find an answer.

auditory

(adjective). Liên quan đến thính giác

Ex: It's an artificial device that stimulates the auditory areas of the brain.

arise

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: We keep them informed of any changes as they arise.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

unfortunately

(adverb). không may

Ex: Unfortunately, I won't be able to attend the meeting.

seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

Ex: Drivers are advised to seek alternative routes.

satisfy

(verb). Làm thoả mãn

Ex: Nothing satisfies him—he's always complaining.

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng

Ex: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.

offer

(verb). Cung cấp

Ex: The hotel offers excellent facilities for families.

implication

(noun). sự liên can, hậu quả

Ex: They failed to consider the wider implications of their actions.

expectation

(noun). Kì vọng

Ex: He failed to live up to his parents' expectations.

cover

(verb). bao hàm, bao gồm

Ex: The survey covers all aspects of the business.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

mixed

(adjective). lẫn lộn

Ex: I listened to her story with mixed emotions.

guilty

(adjective). dằn vặt, tội lỗi

Ex: Sarah had a guilty look on her face.

confess

(verb). thú nhận

Ex: I must confess that I didn't have much faith in her ideas.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

wealth

(noun). Sự giàu có

Ex: During a successful business career, she accumulated a great amount of wealth.

steady

(adjective). Đều đặn, vững chắc

Ex: We've had five years of steady economic growth.

relate

(verb). liên quan

Ex: We shall discuss the problem as it relates to our specific case.

pontifical

(adjective). cố chấp, tỏ vẻ

Ex: He's a little bit pontifical, and it can get on your nerves.

highly

(adverb). rất

Ex: The US car market is highly competitive.

erudite

(adjective). học rộng, uyên bác

Ex: The professor was entertaining as well as erudite.

document

(verb). Ghi nhận, ghi lại

Ex: Urban life in the nineteenth century is well documented.

autobiographical

(adjective). có tính chất tự truyện

Ex: A lot of the incidents in the book actually happened to him, he concedes: but it is not purely autobiographical.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

content

(noun). nội dung

Ex: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

underpinning

(noun). nền

Ex: He has the capacity to understand the theoretical underpinnings that affect action.

rapidly

(adverb). 1 cách nhanh chóng

Ex: Crime figures are rising rapidly.

prone

(adjective). Dễ bị phải

Ex: Working without a break makes you more prone to error.

perception

(noun). Nhận thức

Ex: We have to change the public's perception that money is being wasted.

neural

(adjective). liên quan đến thần kinh

Ex: Our learning is the result of continued activity along neural pathways via the senses.

insight

(noun). cái nhìn sâu sắc

Ex: There are many valuable insights in her book.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

enormous

(adjective). Khổng lồ

Ex: Universities are under enormous pressure financially.

convey

(verb). truyền tải

Ex: Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

Ex: Several factors had combined to ruin our plans.

bizarre

(adjective). Kì quái

Ex: I found the whole situation very bizarre.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

disorder

(noun). sự rối loạn

Ex: Most people with acute mental disorder can be treated at home.

observation

(noun). sự quan sát

Ex: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.

undergo

(verb). Trải qua

Ex: My mother underwent major surgery last year.

shame

(noun). sự xấu hổ, sự tủi thẹn

Ex: He thinks there's great shame in being out of work and unable to provide for his family.

refuse

(verb). từ chối

Ex: She refused to accept that there was a problem.

delve into

(verb). điều tra

Ex: We must delve back into history to find the reason.

decline

(verb). sụt giảm

Ex: Support for the party continues to decline.

reputable

(adjective). có danh tiếng tốt, đáng tin

Ex: Buy your car from a reputable dealer.

favorable

(adjective). thuận lợi, có ích

Ex: The weather was favorable for a barbecue outside.

treatment

(noun). Việc chữa trị

Ex: The drug is used in the treatment of depression.

enchanted

(adjective). vui thích, hồ hởi

Ex: He was enchanted to see her again after so long.

recognize

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: Most of us recognise the importance of diet.

existence

(noun). Sự tồn tại

Ex: The mere existence of these strange creatures fascinated him.

compare

(verb). so sánh

Ex: We compared the two reports carefully.

analyze

(verb). phân tích, đánh giá

Ex: He tried to analyze his feelings.

method

(noun). Phương pháp

Ex: Which method is the most effective?

call for

(verb). kêu gọi

Ex: They called for the immediate release of the hostages.

undervalue

(verb). đánh giá thấp

Ex: Education is currently undervalued in this country.

underappreciate

(verb). đánh giá thấp

Ex: That man is Les Claypool, a very under appreciated musician.

to somebody’s credit

(verb). làm cho ai xứng đáng với sự khen ngợi

Ex: To her great credit, she does not try to avoid the truth.

therapy

(noun). Trị liệu

Ex: Family therapy involves counselling sessions with some, or all, family members.

realm

(noun). cõi, phạm trù

Ex: At the end of the speech he seemed to be moving into the realms of fantasy.

uncritical

(adjective). không phê phán, không phê bình

Ex: Her uncritical acceptance of everything I said began to irritate me.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

skepticism

(noun). hoài nghi

Ex: Such claims should be regarded with a certain amount of skepticism.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm

Ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

discuss

(verb). thảo luận

Ex: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?

at ease

(adjective). thoải mái

Ex: She was at her ease straight away in the new job.

appear to

(verb). dường như, có vẻ như

Ex: The couple appeared to have nothing in common.

accept

(verb). chấp nhận

Ex: The judge refused to accept his evidence.

rely

(verb). dựa trên, dựa vào

Ex: They had to rely entirely on volunteer workers.

impatient

(adjective). nôn nóng, thiếu kiên nhẫn

Ex: I'd been waiting for twenty minutes and I was getting impatient

fear

(noun). nỗi sợ

Ex: Alan spoke of his fears for the future.

absence

(noun). Sự vắng mặt

Ex: We did not receive any news during his long absence.

perceive

(verb). nhận thức

Ex: This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.

note

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

Ex: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.

melody

(noun). giai điệu

Ex: The melody is then taken up by the flutes.

loss

(noun). mất mát

Ex: He suffered a loss of confidence.

localise

(verb). khoanh vùng

Ex: Electricians worked through the night to localise the faulty switches.

indicate

(verb). chỉ ra, hiển thị

Ex: The survey data indicate a general satisfaction with the process.

harmony

(noun). hòa âm

Ex: It is a simple melody with complex harmonies.

dissociation

(noun). sự tách biệt, sự phân ly

Ex: The work finds a fairly complete dissociation between learning and sleep.

comprehension

(noun). sự hiểu, sự nhận thức

Ex: She has no comprehension of the seriousness of the situation.

component

(noun). Thành phần

Ex: Nitrogen is the main component of air.

varied

(adjective). gồm nhiều loại khác nhau

Ex: With its varied climate, the country attracts both winter and summer sports enthusiasts.

treat

(verb). chữa

Ex: She was treated for depression with medication prescribed by her doctor.

medication

(noun). dược phẩm

Ex: The condition may require prolonged medication.

draw

(verb). rút ra

Ex: What conclusions did you draw from the report?

alleviate

(verb). Giảm nhẹ

Ex: A number of measures were taken to alleviate the problem.

aggravate

(verb). làm xấu đi

Ex: Pollution can aggravate asthma.

neurological

(adjective). thuộc thần kinh, thuộc hệ thần kinh

Ex: Her research focuses on neurological disorders such as multiple sclerosis.’

symptom

(noun). triệu chứng

Ex: Cigarettes can aggravate the symptoms of a cold.

patient

(noun). Bệnh nhân

Ex: Hospitals are treating more patients than ever before.

respond

(verb). phản ứng

Ex: How did they respond to the news?

isolation

(noun). sự cô lập, sự tách biệt

Ex: To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận, phương pháp

Ex: The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.
